description:
Cover the new dual-backend behavior prod-realistically: mock ONLY external boundaries — the `agy` subprocess, git, fs — never internal chunking/merge/config (per the prod-realistic-integration-tests lesson).

- Backend selection: provider dispatch (codex vs gemini) from config.
- Config: provider parsing + per-provider default-model resolution; `model:'latest'` resolution + safe fallback.
- Gemini backend (mock the agy spawn): assert the prompt passed to agy, JSON parsed from stdout, session_id captured from last_conversations.json, resume passes `--conversation`, chunked-independent + cross-phase resume behavior, `classifyAgyError` mappings, empty-output retry, and the T-001 partial-failure session_id passthrough.
- Provider provenance: cross-provider resume produces the clear error.

Acceptance: full suite green including all new cases; no internal product logic mocked; agy is exercised only at the subprocess boundary.
title: Dual-backend test suite
